name: vault-shell
description: Runs the Tauri CLI that web/ installs. The Android project's Gradle build calls back into it as `npm run tauri -- ...` from shells/tauri, and npm finds this file one level up. It sits here, not in shells/tauri, because Tauri takes the folder holding the nearest package.json as the app's root, where tauri.conf.json's beforeBuildCommand runs.
